axes.name: Heroes
axes.definition: A Hero creature or a card that puts Hero creatures or Hero tokens onto the battlefield, for the cards that pump, count, protect, or trigger on Heroes you control or Heroes entering.

axes.name: Villains
axes.definition: A Villain creature, a Villain spell cast, or a card that makes 2/1 menace Villain tokens or other Villain tokens, for the cards that trigger on Villains entering, cost less with Villains, or pump Villains.

axes.name: Artifacts
axes.definition: An artifact permanent, artifact creature, Equipment, Vehicle, or a card that makes artifact tokens (Treasure, Food, Clue), for the cards that count artifacts, trigger on artifacts entering, improvise, or sacrifice artifacts.

axes.name: Equipment
axes.definition: An Equipment card or a card that creates an Equipment token, for the creatures that get bigger when equipped, drain when attacking equipped, connive when equipped, or draw when Equipment enters.

axes.name: +1/+1 counters
axes.definition: A card that puts +1/+1 counters on your creatures, including power-up abilities, connive, enrage, and spells or triggers that add counters, for the cards that reward counters being placed or creatures having counters.

axes.name: Second card each turn
axes.definition: A card that draws you extra cards beyond your draw step, especially cheaply or on the opponent's turn (connive, loot, cantrips, Clues, instant-speed draw), for the cards that trigger whenever you draw your second card each turn or whenever you draw a card.

axes.name: Noncreature spells
axes.definition: A noncreature spell you cast, especially a cheap instant, sorcery, Aura, or Equipment, for prowess creatures and the cards that trigger whenever you cast a noncreature spell or an instant or sorcery.

axes.name: Spells targeting your creatures
axes.definition: A spell that targets a creature you control (pump, protection, Auras you put on your own creatures, flash Equipment that attaches on entering), for the creatures that grow, draw, or gain abilities whenever you cast a spell targeting your creature.

axes.name: Tapping your creatures
axes.definition: A card that taps your own creatures outside of attacking (teamwork costs, crew, tap abilities) or that untaps your creatures so they can be tapped again, for the cards that trigger when your creatures become tapped or are tapped for teamwork.

axes.name: Attacks alone
axes.definition: A card that makes a single attacker good on its own: evasion, menace, first strike, indestructible, Equipment and Auras that stack onto one creature, for the cards that trigger or pump whenever a creature you control attacks alone.

axes.name: Creature cards in graveyard
axes.definition: A card that puts cards, especially creature cards, into your graveyard: self-mill, surveil, connive and other discard, cycling, sacrifice outlets, and creatures that trade in combat, for the cards that turn on with two or more creature cards in your graveyard or return creature cards from it.

axes.name: Sacrifice fodder
axes.definition: A card that gives you spare artifacts or creatures to sacrifice (Treasure, Food, Clue, creature tokens, creatures that want to die), for the cards that sacrifice an artifact or creature as a cost or on entering.

axes.name: Wide boards and tokens
axes.definition: A card that puts several creature bodies onto the battlefield (creature tokens, two-for-one creatures, copy effects), for the cards that pump your whole team, trigger when creatures or tokens enter, count your creatures, or need total power for teamwork and crew.

axes.name: Lands entering
axes.definition: A land, or a card that finds extra lands or lets you play extra lands (basic landcycling, land search, playing lands from the graveyard or library top), for the landfall cards that trigger whenever a land enters under your control.

axes.name: Power-up
axes.definition: A permanent with a power-up ability or another costly activated creature ability, for the cards that make power-up and creature abilities cheaper, let them be activated again, copy them, or add extra counters to them.

axes.name: Enters triggers
axes.definition: A nonland permanent with an enters-the-battlefield trigger, for the cards that flicker or bounce and replay your own permanents or copy your triggered abilities.

axes.name: Life gain
axes.definition: A card that gains you life repeatedly or incidentally (lifelink, Food, drain triggers, the common dual lands that gain 1 life), for the cards that put +1/+1 counters on creatures whenever you gain life.

corrections.reason: Draws a card at each end step when a Hero attacked or entered this turn, an extra card nearly every turn in a Hero deck, and with flash it can do so on the opponent's turn.
The spell targets up to one creature you control (it connives), so casting it triggers Colleen Wing, Mockingbird, Ms. Marvel and Iron Fist.
Bullseye discards a nonland card as a repeatable cost; Moonstone lets you exile and play each discarded card, turning the cost into card advantage.
Each nonland card Bullseye discards for his ETB or activated ability can be played again through Moonstone's discard trigger.
